resource_semantics: Frozen lower=last_NVML_busy_observation minus spawn_observed, upper=first_exit_and_release_observed minus dispatch_before_spawn. These are worker/device reservation brackets and include pre-CUDA CPU source/weight hashing and import. They are not exact physical CUDA occupancy or GPU execution time.
NVML_span_semantics: Descriptive first-to-last observed process presence, not a measured busy-compute integral or rigorous physical residence lower bound without continuity assumptions.
